meta.title: AD Labs EdgeSight — Dashboard Field Contract
privacy_basis: No facial identification. Face detection (YuNet) is redaction-only.
Re-ID is session-scoped (OSNet embeddings, in-memory gallery, TTL prune). No cross-session persistence, no face-ID.
Demographics are k-anonymized (k >= 10) and render only when publishable=true.
Product interest = open-vocab display categories (YOLO-World). Never claimed as POS SKUs or revenue.
Staff tagging is role-based geometry (`staff` zones + dwell threshold), not biometrics.
Track IDs are session-scoped integers from the tracker; never used as customer identities.

GET /api/v1/live.purpose: Frame-synced store+camera live state (matches the YOLO MJPEG HUD). Poll 2s.

GET /api/v1/live/snapshot?camera_id=<id>.purpose: Per-camera frame-synced snapshot (same writer as the HUD). Poll 2s.

GET /api/v1/stream/{camera_id}.cadence: decoded-frame painting (~FEED fps shown in HUD)

POST /api/v1/config/cameras.purpose: Write calibration; edge hot-reloads cameras & tripwires within ~3s.

POST /api/v1/telemetry.current_occupancy: int (LIVE customers on floor now = active tracks, matches HUD)

status_legend.LIVE: Real data today from the named pipeline; renders actual values.
status_legend.PARTIAL: Pipeline/model exists but display is suppressed by privacy thresholds or config; UI shows honest empty state, never a fabricated number.
status_legend.FUTURE: Not implemented for this deployment; field has a defined destination but no producer yet.

metrics.name: Glass-view annotated video
metrics.source: MJPEG annotated帧 (boxes, IDs, tripwires, zones, HUD FEED/MODEL fps)
metrics.privacy_note: IDs are numeric session scope; optional YuNet face redaction.

metrics.name: Footfall in/out (session)
metrics.privacy_note: Counts + wire IDs only.

metrics.name: Footfall history (hourly)

metrics.name: Movement routes (OD arcs)
metrics.privacy_note: Would aggregate by zone-to-zone counts.

metrics.privacy_note: Aggregate only.

metrics.name: Queue congestion alert
metrics.privacy_note: Operational flag only.

metrics.name: Crossing event feed
metrics.privacy_note: Session-scoped track_id; no identity.

metrics.name: Dwell-spike / lingering alerts
metrics.privacy_note: Would use zone dwell aggregates only.

metrics.name: Safety alerts (fall / crowd surge)
metrics.privacy_note: Will never render fabricated alerts.

metrics.name: Staff now (visible on floor)
metrics.source: Staff-zone geometry + sticky dwell tagging (min dwell)
metrics.privacy_note: Role-based geometric tag; no biometrics.

metrics.name: Hardware per staff zone
metrics.privacy_note: Counts only.

metrics.name: Crowd density surface
metrics.privacy_note: Aggregate density only; no incident detection.

metrics.name: Fall / surge / intrusion detection
metrics.privacy_note: Dedicated camera+model required; watchdog NOT pretended today.

metrics.name: Demographic cohorts (age bands, gender split)
metrics.source: Face-box (redaction-only) → INT8 age/gender ONNX → k-anonymity gate (k>=10)

metrics.name: Attention (facing / engagement)
metrics.source: Pose + head-pose enrichment on face boxes
metrics.privacy_note: Enrichment currently disabled in fast perf mode; fields stay honest zeros.

metrics.name: Groups (people-in-company)
metrics.privacy_note: Aggregates; enables only with enrichment.

metrics.name: Phone usage rate
metrics.privacy_note: Enrichment-gated.

metrics.name: Store OWL occupancy (active)
metrics.privacy_note: Overlapping FOVs double-count until consensus ships (documented in occupancy_note).

metrics.name: Net footfall (tripwire net IN-OUT)
metrics.privacy_note: Documented separately from live occupancy; looping sample video yields low net.

metrics.name: Multi-store comparison
metrics.source: Schema supports store_id; second store not deployed

metrics.name: Category viewers / detections / dwell
metrics.source: YOLO-World open-vocab labeled boxes + dwell windows
metrics.privacy_note: Display categories only; explicitly NOT POS SKUs, never revenue.

empty_state_copy.stop_rate: Stop-rate unlocks once entrance-zone dwell thresholds are exposed. The tracker already computes stationary seconds — we show nothing rather than estimate.
empty_state_copy.demographics: Cohort counts unlock after ≥10 anonymous samples inside the privacy window (k-anonymity). The real model runs — we suppress below the threshold by design, not by error.
empty_state_copy.engagement: Attention metrics (facing/phone/groups) activate with pose + head-pose enrichment on this node. Rows show honest zeros today so the queue and footfall numbers are never contaminated.
empty_state_copy.multi_store: Single-store deployment. Multi-store compare activates as soon as a second device registers — store_id is already ingest-ready across the schema.
empty_state_copy.safety: No safety model on this edge node. We will not render fabricated alerts; fall/crowd-surge will only come from a dedicated model.
empty_state_copy.service_timestamps: Per-counter service timestamps need counter-level calibration, which hasn't been drawn yet.
empty_state_copy.routes: Traction is real today (zones + heatmap). Movement-route arcs need the route model and will not be approximated.
empty_state_copy.pos_sku: These are display-interest signals (what shoppers look at), not sales. Connecting a POS feed is a separate, consented integration.
empty_state_copy.reid_cross_cam: Session-scoped person tracker only today. Cross-camera identity fusion requires the ReID gallery task — and stays anonymous unless policy changes.

notes: people_now/net_occupancy = active customer tracks on the floor (matches the YOLO overlay). Tripwire IN/OUT are cumulative session counters.
Rollup occupancy for tripwire cameras was fixed on 2026-10-23: it now uses active tracks instead of IN−OUT net so DB → cloud → dashboard match the HUD.
FEED fps = display_fps (annotated JPEG refresh, what users see). MODEL fps = infer_fps (detection cadence). decode_fps cached decode rate.
Sample footage loops (~20-30s); historical DB rows from earlier runs are real collected data and dated accordingly.
Enrichment tier (pose/face/demographics/products) is config-gated per camera (pipeline.yaml models.*.enabled) plus EDGE_PERF_MODE.
